signature.name: Nairobi National Park
signature.detail: The only national park inside a capital city, where you can see lions, rhinos and giraffes against a skyline backdrop. Go early morning for the best wildlife sightings and cooler temperatures; arrange a guided game drive or self-drive with a 4x4.

signature.name: Giraffe Centre
signature.detail: A conservation centre where you can hand-feed endangered Rothschild's giraffes from a raised platform. Visit on weekdays to avoid crowds; tickets are available at the gate and include a short educational talk.

signature.name: Karen Blixen Museum
signature.detail: The former home of the author of 'Out of Africa', preserved with original furnishings and lush gardens. Take a guided tour for context; it's a short drive from the Giraffe Centre, so combine both in one trip.

signature.name: Nairobi National Museum
signature.detail: Kenya's flagship museum, covering human origins, ethnography and natural history, including the famous Turkana Boy fossil. Allow at least two hours; it's centrally located and easily reached by taxi.

signature.name: Kenyatta International Convention Centre
signature.detail: An iconic tower with a rooftop helipad offering panoramic views of Nairobi. Go on a clear day for the best photos; the observation deck is open to visitors for a small fee.

signature.name: Karura Forest
signature.detail: A serene urban forest with walking and cycling trails, waterfalls and caves. Rent a bike at the entrance or join a guided walk; go early to avoid the heat and bring water.

signature.name: Bomas of Kenya
signature.detail: A cultural village showcasing traditional homesteads and dance performances from Kenya's ethnic groups. Check the performance schedule in advance; it's a short drive from the city centre.

signature.name: Ngong Hills
signature.detail: A scenic ridge offering hiking trails and sweeping views over the Rift Valley. Arrange a guided hike for safety; start early and bring sun protection and water.

transport: Taxis and ride-hailing $5-15 per trip; matatus very cheap
